items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: He played with me. We played all the parades, funerals, and he played in a big band with me.

ctx.x: Made up a band. You know this guy Tats? Yeah.
Did you ever work with him or he worked with you? He worked with people like Tats. Yeah. He worked with people like Tats.
